book.name: Luku
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ LUKU U YORUA

content: Yesu u bɑrɔ ɡoo bɛkiɑ
Tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑruɡiru ɡɑru sɔɔ Yesu duɑ Fɑlisibɑn wiruɡii ɡoon yɛnuɔ u kɑ di. Mɑ bɑ nùn lɑɑkɑri sɑ̃ɑ.
N wee durɔ ɡoo wìn wɑsi yi mɔsɑ u yɔ̃ Yesun wuswɑɑɔ.
Mɑ Yesu u woodɑ yɛ̃robu kɑ Fɑlisibɑ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, n weenɛ bu tɔnu bɛkiɑ tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑruɡiru sɔɔ? Nɡe n ǹ weenɛ.
Bɑ mɑɑri. Yerɑ u bɑrɔ wi tii ɡɑwe u nùn bɛkiɑ mɑ u derɑ u doonɑ.
Mɑ u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛn wɑrɑ, win bii ǹ kun mɛ win nɑɑ yɑ̀ n dɔkɔ wɔri tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑruɡiru sɔɔ, u ǹ koo ye wunɑ fuuku.
Yerɑ bɑ kpɑnɑ bu ɡɑri yi wisi.
Mi n weenɛ ɑ sinɑ
dim soku yerɔ
Ye u lɑɑkɑri kuɑ mɑ be bɑ dim sokɑ nɡe mɑɑ wi, bɑ sin yee bɛɛrɛɡinu ɡɔsimɔ, u bu mɔndu kuɑ u nɛɛ,
sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ nun sokɑ kurɔ kpɑɑ yerɔ, ɑ ku sinɑ sin yee bɛɛrɛɡirɔ. Sɔrɔkudo bɑ koo rɑ ɡoo soku wi u nun bɛɛrɛ kere.
Mɑ wi u bɛɛ kpuro sokɑ u koo nɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ durɔ wi sin yee te wɛ̃ɛyɔ. Sɑɑ yerɑ sekurɑ koo nun mwɑ ɑ kɑ dɑ ɑ sinɑ sin yee birukirɔ.

Adɑmɑ sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ nun dim sokɑ, ɑ doo ɑ sinɑ sin yee birukirɔ, kpɑ wi u nun sokɑ ù n tunumɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ seewo nɛn bɔrɔ ɑ nɑ wuswɑɑɔ. Sɑɑ ye, n ko n sɑ̃ɑ bɛɛrɛ bɑkɑ wunɛ sɔɔ be kpuron wuswɑɑɔ be bɑ sɔ̃ kɑ wunɛ sɑnnu.
Kɑ ɡeemɑ bɑɑwure wi u tii suɑ wɔllɔ, bɑ koo nùn kɑwɑ. Bɑɑwure wi u mɑɑ tii kɑwɑ, bɑ koo nùn suɑ wɔllɔ.

U mɑɑ wi u nùn dim sokɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ tɔmbu yɑɑ dibu ǹ kun mɛ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru sokɑ, ɑ ku wunɛn bɔrɔbɑ soku, ǹ kun mɛ wunɛn mɑɑbu, ǹ kun mɛ wunɛn dusibu, ǹ kun mɛ wunɛn beruse ɡobiɡibu, kpɑ ben tii bu ku rɑɑ nun soku bu kɑ nun kɔsiɑ.
Adɑmɑ sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ tɔmbu dim kɑnɑ, ɑ sɑ̃ɑrobu sokuo kɑ ɑlebuɡibu kɑ kɔ̃ri bɑrɔbu kɑ wɔ̃kobu.
Kɑɑ ko doo nɔɔruɡii yèn sɔ̃ bɑ ǹ mɔ bu kɑ nun kɔsiɑ. Kɑɑ wunɛn kɔsiɑru wɑ Gusunɔn min di sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ koo ɡeeɡibu seeyɑ ɡɔrin di.
Dim bɑkɑm ɡɑri
Ye be bɑ dimɔ kɑ Yesu sɑnnu, ben turo u ɡɑri yi nuɑ mɑ u nɛɛ, doo nɔɔruɡiiwɑ wi u koo di bɑn te Gusunɔ u swĩi sɔɔ.
Mɑ Yesu nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, durɔ ɡoo u dim bɑkɑm sɔɔru kuɑ mɑ u tɔn dɑbiru sokɑ.
Ye dim sɑɑ yɑ turɑ u win sɔm kowo ɡɔrɑ tɔn ben bɑɑwuren mi bu nɑ domi yɑɑ dibu kpuro sɔɔru kpeerɑ.
Adɑmɑ be kpuro bɑ suuru kɑnɑ bɑ nɛɛ, bɑ ǹ fɛɛ wɑsi bu nɑ. Gbiikoo nɛɛ, wi, u ɡberu dwɑ, tilɑsiwɑ u kɑ dɑ u te wɑ.
Kpɑo mɑɑ nɛɛ, wi, u nɛɛ dwɑ wɑsi yiru yiru yen nɔɔbu, mɑ u koo den kɑ yi sɔmburu ko u wɑ.
Kpɑo kpɑm nɛɛ, tɛ̃ ɡerɑ wi, u kurɔ suɑ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ wi, u ǹ kpɛ̃ u nɑ.

Sɔm kowo wi, u ɡɔsirɑ u kɑ be kpuron suuru kɑnɑ bi dɑ u win yinni sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Yerɑ yinni win mɔru seewɑ mɑ u win sɔm kowo sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo fuuku wuun bɑtumɑ kɑ ɡen swɛɛ sɔɔ ɑ kɑ sɑ̃ɑrobu nɑ kɑ ɑlebuɡibu kɑ wɔ̃kobu kɑ kɔ̃ri bɑrɔbu.
Mɑ sɔm kowo wi, u nɛɛ, yinni, ye ɑ mɑn yiire mi, nɑ ye kuɑ. Wee, ɑyerɑ mɑɑ tie.
Mɑ yinni wi, u nɛɛ, ɑ swɛɛ swĩiyɔ kɑ kɑrɑn ɡoonu ɑ tɔmbu duusiɑmɑ kɑ kɑnkɑnsi, kpɑ nɛn yɛnu ɡu yibu.
Domi ɡeemɑ nɑ ɡerumɔ, bɑɑ tɔn ben turo kun mɑɑ nɛn dĩɑnu dendɑmɔ, be, be nɑ ɡbiɑ nɑ sokɑ.
Ye tɔnu koo ko
u kɑ ko Yesun bɔ̃ɔ
Tɔn wɔru ɡunɑ yɑ swɑɑ mɔ̀ bɑ sĩimɔ kɑ Yesu sɑnnu, mɑ u sĩirɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
ɡoo ù n kĩ u mɑn swĩi, mɑ u ǹ mɑn kĩɛ n kere win bɑɑ kɑ win mɛro kɑ win kurɔ kɑ win bibu kɑ win mɑɑbu kɑ wɔnɔbu kɑ win sesubu kɑ mɑm win tiin wɑ̃ɑru, u ǹ kpɛ̃ u ko nɛn bɔ̃ɔ.
Bɑɑwure wi u kun win tiin dɑ̃ɑ bunɑnɑru sue, u kɑ nɛn yirɑ swĩi, u ǹ kpɛ̃ u ko nɛn bɔ̃ɔ.
Nɡe wɑrɑ bɛɛ sɔɔ ù n kĩ u diru bɑni, u ǹ koo ɡinɑ sinɑ u dooru ko u wɑ win ɡobi yì n turɑ u kɑ tu wiru ɡo.
Mɑ n kun mɛ, ù n kpɛɛkpɛɛku surɑ, mɑ u kpɑnɑ u dɑkurɑ, be bɑ ɡu wɑɑmɔ kpuro bɑ koo nùn yɑɑkoru ko,
kpɑ bu nɛɛ, durɔ wi, u bɑnɑ toruɑ, mɑ u kpɑnɑ u ye dɑkurɑ.

Nɡe sunɔ wɑrɑ ù n seewɑ kɑ tɑbu kowobu nɔrɔbun subɑ wɔkuru (10.000) u kɑ tɑbu ko kɑ win sunɔsi ɡoo wi u tɑbu kowobu mɔ nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndu (20.000), u ǹ koo ɡinɑ sinɑ u mɛɛri u wɑ ù n dɑm mɔ u kɑ tɑɑ bi ko?
Ù n wɑ u ǹ kpɛ̃, sɑnɑm mɛ wini kun tunumɑm kpɑ, u koo nùn sɔmɔbu ɡɔriɑ bu nùn bikiɑ ye u koo mɔɔru mwɑ bu ku mɑɑ kɑ tɑbu ko.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɛɛn bɑɑwure wi u kun deri kpuro ye u mɔ, u ǹ kpɛ̃ u ko nɛn bɔ̃ɔ.
Bɔru te tɑ nɔɔ ɡu
Mɑ Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, bɔru
ɡɑ̃ɑ ɡeenɑ, ɑdɑmɑ bɔru tɑ̀ n nɔɔ ɡu, mbɑ bɑ koo mɑɑ kɑ tu dorɑsiɑ.
Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ kɑ tu bukɑtɑ ɡɑɑ mɔ̀ ɡberɔ bɑɑ tɑɑki wɔllɔ bu kɑ tem kɔ̃sisiɑ. Bɑ rɑ kubewɑ tɔɔwɔ. Wi u swɑɑ mɔ u kɑ nɔ, u nɔɔwɔ.

footnotes.text: bɔru - Bɔɔ te bɑ kɑ yɑ̃ mini, tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe bɔɔ swɑ̃ɑru. Tɑ koo kpĩ tu nɔɔ ɡbi.
